tools.name: festival_dates
tools.description:
Hindu festival calendar for a YEAR at a location - the Gregorian date each major
    festival falls on, computed from the panchang (tithi-vyapini + sankranti), not scraped.
    Covers Diwali, Holi-season, Navratri, Janmashtami, Ganesh Chaturthi, Maha Shivaratri,
    Ram Navami, Akshaya Tritiya, Vija

tools.name: check_time
tools.description:
Check whether a SPECIFIC moment is auspicious for an activity.
    datetime_local: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' in the location's local time. For activity='travel', pass
    direction (north/south/east/west) to apply Disha Shool - ask the user for it if they haven't said.
    Returns verdict + reasons/warning

tools.description:

tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description:
Full daily panchang: sunrise/sunset, tithi/nakshatra/yoga/karana, the 5 inauspicious kaalas,
    Abhijit, and the current hora - for a date + location.

tools.name: get_inauspicious_periods
tools.description: Dense: the 5 inauspicious kaalas (Rahu, Gulika, Yamaganda, Ardhaprahara, Kala) + Abhijit for a date+location.

tools.name: get_hora_schedule
tools.description: Dense: the daytime hora schedule (planet + benefic/malefic) for a date+location.
